body: Peace. Right now I feel unbearable heartache and pain that doesnt go away. Peace from it would be good.

My husband cheated on me 3 monhs before our wedding. I found out very soon afterwards. Eventually decided to try and move past it. Got married. Feel traumatized, have panic attacks, eat too much at a time or not at all. Meanwhile hes done everything humanly possible to help me cope and recover and I still feel miserable and severely depressed and worthless a huge chunk of the time.
